oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'the switch presses the User Interface door; off, customers see no microphone' passes: one PUT /api/ops/ui with composer-voice-input false, the line reads 'No microphone: voice is off'. 'the key: from the environment at first, tested, saved here, never shown back, removed after asking' passes. 'the operator’s voice switch: off refuses every handshake (404), unreadable refuses for now (503)' and 'GET /api/speech: the operator’s voice switch off, or unreadable, is unavailable' pass. 'a key saved on /ops is sealed at rest and used before the environment’s' passes. Provider profiles preserve independent fallback settings and sealed tokens across switches; defaults keep ElevenLabs and its legacy key. Fallback tries one configured target before streaming; active listening and TTS stay coherent, old revisions require restart, cancellation and Tracy quotas never fallback; upstream credit failures may try one target before output. VoiceStudio summary commits once; PostgreSQL migration preserves the existing cipher. Widget restored/network-uncertain drafts remain manual while fresh committed speech auto-submits exactly once; late callbacks and partial words cannot replay old prompts. Model failures return safe structured JSON with upstream status. Speech model discovery caches sanitized STT/TTS metadata without inference or changing current profiles/revisions; failed refresh preserves cache/draft; unsupported transports and VoiceStudio ASR overrides are rejected. Eleven v4 uses HTTP Text-to-Dialogue; v4 Turbo uses server-side dialogue WebSocket, validated bounded PCM24k, cancellation, selected-model health probes, no replay after partial audio and refreshed cached compatibility. Widget model402 reports unavailable credits/billing, safe auth/config/rate/timeout reasons do not expose raw upstream data or trigger login, audio or automatic prompt replay.
